_comment: LOOSE BALL RUNS ON. Ball roll friction is applied per FRAME in the shared integrator 0x14408d0f0 (rate^60 per second), so small changes compound hard: 0.991^60 = 0.58/s, 0.9935^60 = 0.68/s. The [6] index is pitch condition; idx 0 and 2 cover most matches (see aerial-pitch-spread.json). stopSpeed is the speed below which the ball is snapped to rest. Apply LAST and alone - this one also lengthens every pass.

edits._note: 0.175 -> 0.12: the ball keeps trickling instead of dying, so it stays contestable
